title: What Ocean Art Expeditions Is
definition: Ocean Art Expeditions: expeditions making art from the ocean.
description:
Ocean Art Expeditions — Signature Edition: expeditions making art from the ocean. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature expedition hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: research vessels rethought, expedition logistics rebuilt, sample ethics reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the exhibition ambition that defines the Signature line.

t: The Signature Vision: Ocean Art Expeditions
title: The Signature Vision: Ocean Art Expeditions
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Ocean Art Expeditions.
description:
The Signature vision of Ocean Art Expeditions does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature expedition hulls program, charter one: master research vessels at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale expedition logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate sample ethics systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Ocean Art Expeditions becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: Readiness Estimator: Ocean Art Expeditions
definition: Estimates Ocean Art Expeditions readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Ocean Art Expeditions components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a expedition hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Ocean Art Expeditions Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Ocean Art Expeditions operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Ocean Art Expeditions installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 90922 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where research vessels monitoring, expedition logistics redundancy, or sample ethics maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Ocean Art Expeditions Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Ocean Art Expeditions: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Ocean Art Expeditions — expeditions making art from the ocean.

Phase 1 — Prove (research vessels): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (expedition logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (sample ethics): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (exhibition): expedition hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and art-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
